name: Hungry Resource Monitor
author: Prakhar Bhatia

sections.description:
🧩 What’s Using My Memory?

Hungry Resource Monitor is a lightweight tool that tracks memory usage, database queries, and execution time across your WordPress site. Identify resource-heavy plugins and themes, clean up database bloat, and receive weekly performance reports.

Key Features

  • Dashboard – View top 5 resource consumers at a glance
  • Server Limits – See PHP memory limits, execution time, and more
  • Cleanup Tools – Remove post revisions, drafts, spam, and transients
  • Unused Assets – Find and delete inactive plugins and themes
  • Email Reports – Configurable daily, weekly, or monthly reports
  • Toolbar Widget – Real-time memory and query stats (admin only)

What Gets Monitored

  • Memory usage (current and peak)
  • Database query count and time
  • Page load execution time
  • Per-request statistics

Cleanup Options

  • Post revisions
  • Auto-drafts
  • Trashed posts and comments
  • Spam comments
  • Expired transients
  • Orphaned postmeta
sections.installation:
1. Upload the hungry-resource-monitor folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Navigate to ‘Resource Monitor’ in your admin menu
  4. Configure settings as needed
sections.faq:
Does this plugin slow down my site?

No. The plugin uses minimal resources and only tracks data on page load. Tracking can be disabled in settings.

How long is data stored?

By default, 30 days. This is configurable in Settings.

Is this compatible with caching plugins?

Yes. Resource tracking happens before output caching.
